sub_menus.name: ISP Overview
sub_menus.description: Provides a comprehensive view of overall ISP network traffic and routing metrics.

sub_menus.name: Router Geo Map
sub_menus.description: Visualizes the geographic location of routers and regional traffic distribution.

sub_menus.name: Peering Analytics
sub_menus.description: Analyzes peering traffic volume, exchange points, and autonomous system metrics.

sub_menus.name: Peering Analytics Drilldown
sub_menus.description: Provides a detailed breakdown of traffic for specific peering partners and ASNs.

sub_menus.name: Country Analytics
sub_menus.description: Analyzes traffic patterns and bandwidth consumption grouped by destination and source country.

sub_menus.name: Country Analytics Drilldown
sub_menus.description: Drills down into traffic analytics for specific countries and IP subnets.

sub_menus.name: Prefix External Analytics
sub_menus.description: Analyzes external BGP prefix advertisements, routing paths, and traffic volume.

sub_menus.name: Prefix Analytics Drilldown
sub_menus.description: Drills down into traffic metrics and active IP allocations for specific prefixes.
